summary: The principal of a school emphasizes the importance of E-Rate for providing reliable broadband infrastructure for modern public education and urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the program rather than eliminate or restrict it.

claims.argument: E-Rate has enabled schools to provide reliable broadband support for students
claims.evidence_quote: I therefore respectfully urge the Commission to: 1. Reject any proposal to sunset or eliminate the E-Rate program; 2. Reject proposals that would unnecessarily narrow E-Rate eligibility or restrict support based solely on geography or other criteria that would leave students without adequate support; 3. Preserve support for the connectivity and internal network infrastructure schools need to provide reliable educational access; and 4. Work with schools and other stakeholders to strengthen and modernize E-Rate rather than reduce its role in public education. E-Rate has enabled schools (public and private) and libraries to build and maintain the connectivity necessary for students and patrons to participate fully in modern education.
